title: Concept: OS command execution via os.execute (lua) — review required
description: In lua, os.execute executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (an argument-vector launcher instead of the shell) are lua-specific.
applicability: lua codebases that launch external processes through os.execute; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
